steps.name: Open the world list from Minecraft's main menu
Wait for the world list to finish rendering
Confirm the existing creative world is visible
Open the My World edit screen
Wait for My World settings
Scroll the settings sidebar toward pack controls
Finish scrolling the settings sidebar to pack controls
Wait for the pack controls
Open Behavior Packs
Wait for Behavior Packs to finish rendering
Confirm the Behavior Packs screen is open
Open Available Behavior Packs
Wait for available behavior packs
Confirm the imported behavior pack is available
Activate the imported behavior pack
Wait for Minecraft's add-on stacking warning
Confirm the add-on stacking warning
Accept the add-on stacking warning
Wait for behavior and dependent resource activation
Open Resource Packs
Wait for active resource packs
Scroll the active resource-pack list
Wait for the active imported resource pack row
Confirm the imported resource pack is active
Scroll the settings sidebar back toward Play
Finish scrolling the settings sidebar back to Play
Wait for the world Play button
Launch My World locally in creative mode
Wait for My World to finish loading
Open the crafting table directly in front of the player
Wait for the crafting table interface
Confirm the crafting table interface is open
Focus the Creative inventory search field for emerald
Search the Creative inventory for emerald
Wait for emerald search results
Pick the first emerald stack
Place emerald in the top-center recipe slot
Pick the second emerald stack
Place emerald in the middle-center recipe slot
Clear the Creative inventory search
Focus the Creative inventory search field for stick
Search the Creative inventory for stick
Wait for stick search results
Pick a vanilla stick stack
Place stick in the bottom-center recipe slot
Wait for the crafted sword output
Take the crafted Emerald Test Sword output
Put the crafted sword in the seventh inventory hotbar slot
Close the crafting interface
Wait for the creative HUD
Select the crafted green sword in the HUD hotbar
Confirm the crafted sword's localized display name

cleanupSteps.name: Open the pause menu
Wait for the pause menu
Save and quit to the world list
Wait for the world list
Open the My World edit screen (cleanup)
Wait for My World settings (cleanup)
Scroll the settings sidebar toward pack controls (cleanup)
Finish scrolling the settings sidebar to pack controls (cleanup)
Wait for the pack controls (cleanup)
Open Behavior Packs (cleanup)
Wait for Behavior Packs Active tab
Deactivate the just-activated behavior pack (top of Active list)
Wait for the removal confirmation dialog
Confirm behavior pack removal (Just continue)
Wait for the behavior pack deactivation to finish
Open Resource Packs (cleanup)
Wait for Resource Packs Active tab
Scroll the active resource-pack list (cleanup)
Wait for the scrolled resource-pack list
Deactivate Emerald Test Sword Resources if uniquely active
